node.statement: By def-ha-map and product compatibility, D lies in M_{n,1} tensor S_{P,Q}, so take Y=D in the preceding estimate. Validated node 1.2 gives q_P(D)^2=<D,D>_n>=0. Hence q_P(D)^2<=2*C_as*e*q_P(D)*||Z||*q_R(X). If q_P(D)=0 the desired bound is immediate; if q_P(D)>0, divide by q_P(D). Thus q_P(D)<=2*C_as*e*||Z||*q_R(X). Taking C_act:=2*C_as and the positive universal e_act above proves the unconditional root estimate.
